   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Sep 11, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Karen Gump_, Sep 11, 2026, 1/5: "I am having issues with the sleep apnea part, and the blood pressure part wants me to recalibrate after every single time I use it. I am not sure if these are normal issues or not on the Galaxy Watch 9 or not but these issues are not great and I am not happy with this."
            2. _Hicks_, Sep 7, 2026, 1/5: "Die von Samsung upgedatete App setzt One UI 9 auf der Watch voraus - diese wird erst im Laufe der Zeit verteilt. Bis es soweit ist, muss man erst mal mit Bugs rechnen. Zuletzt hilft nur App neu installieren - Synchronisieten geht jetzt bei mir wieder. @Samsung: Großartige IT-Leistung!! Erst mal die Wasserleitung verlegen und sich dann um die Anschlüsse kümmern. Der dumme Anwender verschwendet einstweilen seine Zeit mit abschöpfen."
            3. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
